title: No DNSSEC — DNS cache poisoning risk

remediation: Enable DNSSEC at DNS provider (systemdns.com) and publish DS record in parent zone.

remediation: Replace unsafe-inline with nonce-based CSP or hash-based script/style allowances.

title: Missing X-Frame-Options on port 80

remediation: Add X-Frame-Options: DENY (or CSP frame-ancestors) to all server blocks including port 80.

remediation: Remove hmac-sha1 from MACs in sshd_config, use only hmac-sha2-256/512.

proof_of_existence: CSP header contains 'unsafe-inline' directive in script-src or style-src policy.
